FaceMeX guide

Online learning support that keeps you involved

Digital learning works best when it helps you engage with a subject rather than only consume information. FaceMeX combines an AI assistant with tools for lesson review and guided practice.

Start learningRead practical guides

Ask, review and revisit

Use the assistant to ask follow-up questions about a concept, request a structured explanation or revisit a point from your notes. Keep the original course or lesson as the authority for what you need to learn.

Work from learning material

Watch lessons helps you find video learning content and work with lesson information you provide. You can ask for a recap or revision notes, then compare them with the lesson itself.

Learn through practical activities

Practical Lab offers guided activities across areas such as biology, science, mathematics and environmental studies. Use each activity to explore a concept and follow appropriate real-world safety instructions.

Use AI thoughtfully

AI can make mistakes and may not reflect your syllabus or local requirements. Check important facts, use your own reasoning, and follow your institution’s rules for AI-assisted work.

Frequently asked questions

Is FaceMeX a replacement for school or a teacher?

No. FaceMeX provides AI assistance and learning tools; it does not replace a teacher, course, assessment or official learning resource.

Can I learn at my own pace?

You can ask questions and revisit explanations in the workspace at a pace that suits your study session. Your access to specific tools may depend on your account plan.
